test_title: PYST 17: SSC CHSL 2024 - English (Held On: 05 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been divided into four parts. Identify the part that contains an error.

This is / a doll / and there is / a umbrella.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "a umbrella" is incorrect.
 
• The correct article to use before the noun "umbrella" is "an" because "umbrella" begins with a vowel sound.
 
• The phrase should be "an umbrella" for correct grammatical usage.
 
• Thus, the error is in **Option 2** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"This is a doll and there is an umbrella."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1: "a doll"** – This part of the sentence is correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **3: "and there is"** – This part of the sentence is correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **4: "This is"** – This part of the sentence is correct and does not require any changes.
